market_context: The Nasdaq-100 jumped 3.40% to 27,907.63 (QQQ +3.54% to $679.35) as dip-buyers returned to chips and AI after last week’s midterm-driven rout; a drop in oil cooled inflation worries and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose about 6.9%, even as Nvidia slumped on a board probe of CEO Jensen Huang.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-09 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.
